title: Installing Playwright
why: 第一次摸底：选一篇中等偏易、改编自真实 Playwright 安装文档的材料，句子短、以一般现在时为主，正好配合本周的「句子主干」和「时态」；里面复现了你生词本里的 specify、assume、depend on、corresponding。
focus: 第一遍别查词，把不认识的词都点出来；第二遍每句先找主语和谓语，例如 The command asks you a few questions → command | asks。
text:
Playwright is a test framework for modern web apps. It runs your tests in three browsers: Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. It works on Windows, Linux, and macOS.

This guide assumes that Node.js is already on your computer. To add Playwright to a project, you run one command: npm init playwright@latest

The command asks you a few questions. First, you choose TypeScript or JavaScript. TypeScript is the default. Then you specify a name for the tests folder. You also decide whether to install the browsers now. If you run the command again later, it does not overwrite your existing tests.

After the install, the project has two new things. The first is a config file, playwright.config.ts. It holds your settings, such as browsers, timeouts, and retries. The second is a tests folder with a small example test.

By default, the tests run headless. This means you do not see a browser window. They also run in parallel, and the results appear in the terminal. Many settings have a corresponding command-line option. For example, --headed shows the browser, and --project=chromium runs only one browser. So you do not always depend on the config file.

glossary.meaning: 框架（一整套写测试、跑测试的工具）
覆盖（把原来的内容写掉）
无头模式（运行时不显示浏览器窗口）

questions.q: What happens if you run the install command again?
